response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS cnt FROM Playlist p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT c.PlaylistId, c.cnt AS TrackCount, c.cnt * 1.0 / NULLIF(a.avg_cnt, 0) AS Ratio FROM c CROSS JOIN a ORDER BY (c.cnt * 1.0 / NULLIF(a.avg_cnt, 0)) IS NULL, Ratio DESC LIMIT 10
